svg.title: India's international submarine cables
svg.text: Where the cables that carry the country's overseas internet traffic come ashore
India's overseas internet traffic rides 20 submarine cable systems. 18 of them land at Mumbai or Chennai, and Mumbai alone takes 16. Circles are scaled
by cable count; the dashed line is the domestic Chennai–Andaman & Nicobar system.
Data: TeleGeography submarine cable map, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (April 2022 snapshot). Coastlines: Natural Earth.
